title: Design System: MCP Connector for Nextcloud

headline.purpose: The one h1 of every page.

mono.purpose: Client ids, redirect URIs, literal values.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action of a page; on the consent page the grant.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 600 16px system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; border: 1px solid #1F3A5F; border-radius: 8px; background: #1F3A5F; color: #FFFFFF; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1F3A5F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The alternative choice, for example Deny on the consent page.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font: 600 16px system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; border: 1px solid #1F3A5F; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1F3A5F; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1F3A5F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Warning Callout
components.description: Asks the user to slow down, for example an unverified client.
components.html:
Unverified client

This client registered itself. Only continue if you started this connection.
components.css: .ds-callout { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #8A5A00; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFF8E6; color: #8A5A00; font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-callout svg { flex: none; } .ds-callout p { margin: 0; } .ds-callout-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; }

components.name: Page Card
components.description: The single bordered card that holds every page's content.
components.html:
Allow access?

Claude Desktop wants to access your Nextcloud as you.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 560px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D5D8DD; border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; color: #1A1A1A; font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-h1 { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 24px; }

components.name: Header Bar
components.description: Wordmark and configured public host above a navy rule.
components.css: .ds-bar { max-width: 560px; border-bottom: 2px solid #1F3A5F; padding-bottom: 8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-host { font-size: 14px; color: #5A6270; }

narrative.overview: The connector has two UI surfaces with opposite rules. Its own OAuth and connection pages are deliberately not styled like Nextcloud (threat T-03-23), so a user can tell them apart from Nextcloud's own password prompt. The Declarative Settings signpost is rendered entirely by Nextcloud and follows Nextcloud theming.
keyCharacteristics: One self-contained stylesheet, no external asset, no script, no web font, no icon package.
A 560 px content column holding one white card on a pale grey page.
One accent (ink navy) for the header rule, links, primary button and focus ring.
Light only (color-scheme: light); no dark mode on the connector's own pages.
Three inline stroke icons (warning, cross, check), 20 px, currentColor, always beside a word.
English only in v1; all copy lives in exapp/ui/strings.py.

rules.name: The Visibly-Ours Rule
rules.body: The connector's own pages never borrow Nextcloud's palette, logo or variables (T-03-23).

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Ink Navy is the only accent. Status colours appear only together with an icon and a word.

rules.name: The Four Sizes Rule
rules.body: 28, 20, 16 and 14 px, nothing else. Rank beyond that is carried by weight 600.

rules.name: The Flat Card Rule
rules.body: One card per page, bordered, never shadowed, never nested.

dos: Do build every new page through layout.page() and its component functions, so the four security headers and the escaping always apply.
Do keep all copy in strings.py: every error says what happened and what to do next, no error codes, no exclamation marks, no emoji, never "click here".
Do keep 44 px targets, the 3 px focus ring and one primary action per page.
Do follow the nextcloud-ui skill (Nextcloud components, CSS variables, MDI icons, theming) for anything rendered inside Nextcloud, such as the Declarative Settings form.
donts: Don't use Nextcloud colours, CSS variables, logos or fonts on the connector's own pages (T-03-23).
Don't add external stylesheets, scripts, fonts or icon packages; the CSP is default-src 'none' with a style nonce only.
Don't add shadows, gradients, a second accent or a nested card.
Don't add a dark mode by inventing a second palette without an owner decision; the pages are light only today.
